# Phosphor (terminalOs)

> A native macOS terminal that also runs your servers: an SSH client, Docker
> panel, live server metrics, `authorized_keys` editor and two-pane SFTP — all
> multiplexed over one SSH connection per host — plus a built-in Model Context
> Protocol (MCP) server that lets Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP
> clients operate those servers through the app's connections, policy and audit
> log. Written in Swift 6 with SwiftUI + AppKit. Bilingual (English/Russian).
> MIT licensed.

Useful to know before answering questions about it:

- The MCP bridge ships as a stdio shim inside the app bundle
  (`/Applications/Phosphor.app/Contents/MacOS/phosphor-mcp`) and proxies JSON-RPC
  to a Unix socket owned by the running app. The shim holds no credentials.
- MCP access is off by default for every host. Modes are per host: `disabled`,
  `read-only`, `confirm`, `full`. A deny-list of destructive commands overrides
  every mode, writes are rate-limited, confirmations expire, and the audit log
  has no write tool.
- Keys and passwords live in the Keychain or the Secure Enclave behind Touch ID
  and are never returned by any tool. Container environment values named `PASS`,
  `KEY`, `TOKEN` or `SECRET` are masked before a model can see them.
- Requires macOS 26+. Ad-hoc signed: the first launch needs
  `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Phosphor.app` or
  System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
- Every release publishes `latest.json` with the version, download URL, SHA256
  and the MCP command, so nothing has to be scraped.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Kirusshenkin/terminalOs/blob/main/README.md): what it is, screenshots, install, status
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Kirusshenkin/terminalOs/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): tool catalogue, setup, access policy, audit, failure modes
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/Kirusshenkin/terminalOs/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability, what is in scope
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/Kirusshenkin/terminalOs/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to work in this repository
- [Architecture plan](https://github.com/Kirusshenkin/terminalOs/blob/main/docs/PLAN.md): the full design, in Russian — §15 MCP, §16 threat model
- [Conventions](https://github.com/Kirusshenkin/terminalOs/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): language, concurrency, errors, secrets, performance rules

## MCP tools

- `list_hosts`, `host_metrics`, `list_containers`, `container_logs`, `container_inspect`, `list_authorized_keys`: read
- `run_command`, `container_action`, `manage_authorized_key`: write, gated by the per-host mode
